blocks.text: Its main function is to attract foreign nationals to preparatory and language courses and provide other training programmes for citizens of the Kyrgyz Republic. Programmes have different durations. Classes are held five to six days a week, two to three sessions per day. Alongside their studies, learners are introduced to the historical, cultural and national characteristics of Kyrgyzstan. The centre organises an extensive cultural programme including theatre performances, city museums, art exhibitions and trips to attractions in Chüy Region, such as Burana Tower, Ala-Archa National Park and the Ata-Beyit museum complex.
